title: US plan to defund and dismantle the Ocean Observatories Initiative

charter.in: The Trump administration's 2026 plan to defund and dismantle the US Ocean Observatories Initiative (OOI), an ocean-observing network, and what its loss would do to ocean data and to weather, climate and disaster forecasts and warnings.
out: Other US cuts to weather and climate agencies' budgets and staff
Ocean warming and sea-surface temperature records

entries.title: Trump plan would cut key sea data, raise forecast errors
entries.why: Reports the plan to dismantle the US ocean-observing network and the forecast errors its loss would bring; El Niño forecasting is one thing it would degrade.

entries.title: US cuts threaten disaster warnings ahead of El Niño
entries.why: An op-ed on the same ocean-observing cuts, framed by the coming El Niño: it repeats the known plan and warns what disaster warnings would lose.
